text: The Nagini spike worked, so Python's proof path (D-0024) is Nagini 1.3.1. A proved core lives in files marked `# +nagini`, and each function's contract restates one TLA+ action, as with Gobra. It still runs as plain Python, against a no-op stand-in for Nagini's contract library, and it still has to pass conformance. Nagini runs with no network, in an image built from a recipe inside Invariant: linux/amd64 only, so every machine gets the same Z3, with the base pinned by digest and every Python package by wheel hash. Receipts name the recipe by its hash. The Java runtime comes from Debian and isn't pinned yet.
